title: Mean composite objective in the main scenarios
note: n=30 per scene/method. Search FE: 500 S1-S3, 375 S4-S6. Rules: 1 FE. Lower is better.

title: Extended search comparison and exclusive/tied best counts
note: 48 paired instances, 320 FE. Unique/tied/non-best are separate; tolerance 1e-12.

title: Search methods and budgets with identical initial populations
note: n=20 paired instances per stratum. Same initial population and same decoder; 14 initial evaluations included.

title: Ablation variants reevaluated with common objective weights
note: S4; n=20; 400 FE. -F/-RF also changed the search objective. Common rescoring does not remove that confound.

title: Component interventions with the same objective and initial encoding
note: n=20 per stratum. Uniform allocation changes decoded initial resources, not raw initial encodings.

title: Parameter sensitivity under a fixed objective
note: S4; n=6; 280 FE. The objective-weight sweep changes the metric scale and remains supplementary.

title: New-instance tests of prespecified resource-allocation temperatures
note: n=20 per scene; 320 FE. Gain denominator is each 0.8 result. Pointwise paired 95% CI; Holm p in 24-test family.

title: Scenario-wise reoptimization with a fixed algorithm configuration
note: n=15; 350 FE searches, 1 FE rule. Optimization and evaluation both observe the changed state.

title: Composite objective on six new-instance groups with prespecified configurations
note: n=20; 320 FE searches, 1 FE rule. Only RFOTO-ABC was evaluated at theta 1.6; not a decoder-controlled cross-temperature ranking.

title: RFOTO-ABC problem scale and runtime
note: n=10; 320 FE. Scenario also changes with scale, so this is not an isolated complexity-order estimate.

title: Independent-episode summaries of rolling optimization
note: Three independent 50-slot episodes; episode means are the independent units. Searches use 110 FE per slot; rules use 1 FE.
